brief: The school library at night, moonlight through a window: a small blue-black spirit with ink-stained wisps writing in the air with a reed pen, faint glowing lines of verse trailing behind it; you, Dādī and Śuka peering round a shelf; the tree of names glowing softly in a corner.
notes: Painting reviewed against its exact source brief. Every visible text string compared with the recorded source text; reference font inspected when needed. This is direct visual review, not an OCR-service result.
